title: ToyFoodConveyorBeltDetection
description: Object detection is used on 16 types of toy food travelling along a conveyor belt.
long_description: This project was built for a demo in order to showcase multiple complex objects being detected at the same time, while in motion on a conveyor belt. It was developed in around 20 hours and is part of a larger application for detecting toy foods.
